subject: MAP: Technical evaluation plan & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-20T15:10:00Z
Subject: Recap + MAP next steps (technical eval milestone)

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. As promised, here’s a quick recap and a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone focused on the technical evaluation we discussed. I captured the high-level success criteria we heard and a proposed timeline. Please review and confirm or mark changes.

Quick recap:
- Goal: Validate that Redwood can meet Acme’s latency and cost targets for interactive customer-facing flows, and that model output quality meets the primary NLU benchmarks.
- Primary stakeholders: Samantha Lee (Product), Tom Wu (Platform), Marissa (AE), Dev (Solutions), Avery (SE).
- Next milestone: Technical evaluation (POC/benchmark).

Draft MAP milestone: Technical evaluation plan (owner: Acme + Redwood SE)
- Objective: Run a 2-week technical evaluation to verify latency p95 <= 250ms for 512-token responses under a 50 RPS sustained test, and cost target <= $0.30 per 1k tokens (end-to-end infra + model).
- Success criteria:
  - Latency: p95 <= 250ms (95th percentile) for representative prompt set (see attached).
  - Quality: Passing accuracy/intent F1 >= 92% on the provided eval set, and human review score >= 4/5 on 50 sampled responses.
  - Cost: projected steady-state cost <= $0.30 / 1k tokens for the selected model/config.
- Model shortlist (initial): Llama 2 13B (HF), Mistral Instruct 7B, Falcon 40B-Instruct (quantized variants where applicable). Redwood will provide recommended quantized variants and performance profiles.
- Redwood responsibilities:
  - Provide baseline benchmark harness, sample prompts, and recommended model/quantization profiles.
  - Spin up a slot on Redwood Dedicated (or a short private endpoint) for the test, provide test endpoints and simple load script.
- Acme responsibilities:
  - Provide representative prompt set and eval labels (deadline: 2026-06-26).
  - Point-of-contact for infra access and firewall whitelisting (Tom).
- Target dates:
  - Data & eval set delivered by Acme: 2026-06-26
  - Test window: 2026-06-29 to 2026-07-12
  - Evaluation results & decision: by 2026-07-16
- Dependencies:
  - Network whitelists and any procurement for test VPC by 2026-06-28.
  - Access to sample production traces for realistic load shaping.

I attached a starter MAP (ACME-MAP-v1.xlsx) and the tech requirements doc. If that looks good I’ll update the MAP and put the milestone into our HubSpot deal.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: ACME-MAP-v1.xlsx, tech-eval-requirements.pdf
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@acme.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap + MAP next steps (technical eval milestone)

Thanks Marissa — this looks like a solid starting point. A few quick notes:

- The latency target aligns with our UX bar. Would prefer p95 <= 200ms if achievable, but we can validate in the test.
- Cost target: that $0.30 / 1k tokens is in the ballpark; need to see model-specific numbers.
- We’ll get the eval set to you by EOD Friday (2026-06-26). Tom will handle the network whitelist request — copying him here.

Quick ask: can Redwood provide an estimated test cost and a short runbook for how the Dedicated slot will be provisioned? That will help our infra team approve the window quickly.

On timing, the proposed test window works for us.

— Samantha
Samantha Lee
Director of Product | Acme Corp

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. Attaching an updated MAP (v1.1) with your note about aiming for p95 200ms as a stretch goal. Below are the practical next steps we’ll take from the Redwood side: 

Redwood deliverables before the test window:
- Estimated test cost (one-time for the 2-week window): ~$1,800–$2,500 (depends on chosen model/quant). We'll provide a more precise estimate once we pick the model variant.
- Provisioning steps: we’ll provision a short-lived Dedicated slot (or private endpoint) and share an endpoint + API key; typical lead time 48–72 hours after network access is confirmed.
- Baseline harness: we’ll share a JMeter/locust script and instructions for running the 50 RPS sustained profile.

Updated milestone summary (short):
- Deliverable: Technical evaluation report with latency/cost/quality KPIs
- Owner: Marissa (Redwood AE) / Avery (Redwood SE) / Samantha (Acme Product)
- Targets: p95 <= 250ms (stretch 200ms), cost <= $0.30 / 1k tokens
- Window: 2026-06-29 to 2026-07-12

Please confirm and I’ll lock the MAP in HubSpot and send a calendar invite for a 30-min kickoff the morning of 2026-06-29.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: RE: MAP v1 (updated) + Redwood test details

Thanks team — quick technical notes from my side:

- Model shortlist rationale: Llama 2 13B tends to have good instruction-following with reasonable latency when quantized; Mistral Instruct 7B is often the best cost/latency tradeoff for conversational workloads; Falcon 40B-Instruct gives higher quality on some NLU tasks but needs more careful quantization and larger instance types.
- For a 50 RPS sustained test we recommend testing two candidates (a smaller optimized model and a larger higher-quality model) to compare cost/quality.
- I’ll prepare the exact quantization/build recommendations and expected p95 numbers for each candidate by EOD 2026-06-24.

If you can confirm the eval set delivery date (2026-06-26) I’ll start the perf/quant sims.

— Avery
